text:
Nora: Quick props to Jin and Mei for sorting the all-hands AV glitch  Clap sound came back mid-way and captions re-enabled — saved the recording.

Jin: Had to swap an HDMI->USB-C adapter and toggle the RTMP bridge. Ran: `./start_broadcast --source=room-a --captions=on`  Added a short note to the ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/all-hands-av

Mei: Also looped in Carlos for the captions token fix  He spotted the missing encoder key in the stream settings.

Carlos: No biggie! Happy to help. Also left a spare USB-C adapter at the front desk (label: "AV backup").

Theo: KUDOS CHAIN TIME  Adding Jin for heroics.

kudos-bot: Theo gave Jin a "Bright Mic" kudos (reason: quick AV fix, kept recording clean)

Nora: Also shoutout to cheer-bot for pinging a missed speaker reminder earlier  Saved us from a longer gap.

cheer-bot: Reminder: next all-hands mic check at 09:45 PT. :bell:

Mei: Can we add a "mic-check" checklist to the all-hands doc? quick vote: yes/no

Nora: yes please

Jin: I'll draft a three-step pre-show check and drop it here: https://redwood.internal/docs/all-hands-av (will include test audio, captions toggle, backup adapter)

Carlos: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/tech-help-teamwork-xyz456

kudos-bot: Mei gave Carlos a "Caption Sleuth" kudos (reason: found encoder token) :trophy:

Theo: Side note: whoever brings cookies to the retro gets extra kudos  cookie

Nora: Small fixes, big relief. Thanks team  heart
